fact: On 23 October 2026 the SPIVTEN head said the 2026-2030 AI roadmap, validated on 19 June 2026 and not yet officially published, plans 30 billion FCFA over five years, and that an AI Council is envisaged with its attachment still to be decided.
title: Burkina : une feuille de route IA de 30 milliards de FCFA
